name: Emissary Valustraa
summary: Emissary Valustraa is a draenei diplomat stationed within Darnassus, acting as a liaison between her people and the night elves. Positioned inside the Temple of the Moon near High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, she helps direct draenei newcomers venturing through Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Diplomatic Presence in Darnassus
sections.body: Standing within the tranquil sanctuary of the Temple of the Moon, Emissary Valustraa represents draenei interests at the heart of Darnassus. Stationed near High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, she acts as a bridge between the Kaldorei leadership and the recently arrived draenei. Recognizing that newcomers must prove themselves reliable allies, she coordinates with agents beyond the boughs of Teldrassil, sending travelers southward to assist night elf settlements such as Astranaar in Ashenvale.

faq.answer: Emissary Valustraa is a draenei emissary stationed in Darnassus. She resides inside the Temple of the Moon, representing her people and offering guidance to draenei adventurers navigating the night elves' capital.

faq.q: Where can I find Emissary Valustraa?
faq.answer: She is located inside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, positioned near High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

faq.q: What is Valustraa's role for draenei travelers?
faq.answer: Valustraa helps draenei integrate with Alliance efforts on Kalimdor. She directs capable draenei adventurers to Astranaar in Ashenvale to assist Vindicator Palanaar and aid the struggling night elf settlements.

angles.text: Valustraa represents the diplomatic ties linking the draenei to the Alliance leadership in Kalimdor, coordinating support for settlements under pressure.
Standing beside High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, Valustraa serves as a constant reminder of the Kaldorei's new interstellar allies.
